spots.title: Upper arm
spots.why: The lake narrows toward the incoming river or creek; moving water carries food.

walleye.name: Walleye
walleye.bait: jig and minnow or crankbait along the edge

perch.name: Yellow perch
perch.bait: small jig or minnow near bottom

smallmouth.name: Smallmouth bass
smallmouth.bait: hair jig or blade bait, slow

largemouth.name: Largemouth bass
largemouth.bait: slow jig or drop-shot near the bottom

spots.bait: jig and minnow or crankbait along the edge

spots.title: Steep ledge
spots.why: A sharp wall beside deep water; fish hang along the edge at the depth they like.
